name: Rubbish Disposal Chamber
desc1: This square stone chamber is somewhat hot and is unlit. The floor
desc2: appears to be made of metal, and a dividing line in the centre
desc3: suggests that both halves can open, dropping the contents of the room
desc4: into a pit below. A large warning sign has been posted on the wall
desc5: here, and beside it, set in an iron mounting, is a worn lever.
